{{Quote|We've got Gamble Squadron en route to your position to provide some extra firepower. Gamble One - the General has command.''"<br />"''Roger that. Gamble Squadron at your service, General. Just let us know what you want blown up.|A naval clone and Gamble One|<ref name="CWA" />}}
'''Gamble One''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]]<ref name="CWA" /> created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] from the [[Clone template/Legends|genetic template]] of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]]<ref name="Clone Databank" /> to serve in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="CWA" /> which spanned from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> As a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CWA" /> [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of Fett,<ref name="Clone Databank" /> they had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin<ref name="Skin" /> and stood at 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Clone Databank" /> Gamble One led the [[Seventh Fleet (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Seventh Fleet's]] [[Gamble Squadron]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. The clone wore [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with markings on the top of the [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. At some point during the war, Gamble Squadron was deployed to the [[Fire/Legends|fiery]] world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to aid the efforts of [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] and a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi General]] in combating a counter attack by the Separatist-aligned [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].<ref name="CWA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Gamble One led their [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]] and proceeded to [[Bomb/Legends|bombard]] the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|ground forces]], which helped lead to a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] victory.<ref name="CWA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Gamble One appeared in a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] in the [[2010]] massively multiplayer [[Star Wars video games|online game]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] during the "Deception on Mustafar" level of the "Republic Defender" game mode. When Gamble Squadron arrives during the level, the player is given the "Y-WING SPECIAL ATTACK" ability. This article assumes that the player chooses to use the ability, which is what initiates Gamble Squadron into performing their bombing runs. If the player does not activate the ability, then Gamble One and the rest of the squadron do not play a role in the battle.<ref name="CWA" />
